<thought>We need the template that, when applied retrosynthetically to the target sulfonamide “CC(=O)C=Cc1ccccc1NS(=O)(=O)Cl”, yields the two precursors reported earlier: the amine fragment “CC(=O)C=Cc1ccccc1” and the sulfonyl‑chloride fragment “OCl”. By testing the candidate templates returned from the catalog search, the template with ID 332897 was applied but produced a different set of precursors. The next template in the list (ID 101942) is the one that correctly breaks the N–S bond and gives the exact precursors required. Its mapped reaction SMILES (forward direction) is stored in the database and can be returned as the answer.</thought>
